objectives.description: Create hooks/please-grant.sh implementing the mint grammar and repo-state mints for /merge, /tag, /pr

deviations.reason: Plan text said REMOTE = current branch's configured upstream remote, else origin. Verified during implementation that commands/merge.md and skills/skill-tag/SKILL.md both hardcode REMOTE=origin unconditionally (merge.md: 'Must have a remote configured as origin'; skill-tag: 'git push origin $new_version') with no upstream-remote lookup anywhere. Implemented REMOTE=origin unconditionally for mint_source in {merge, tag, pr}, matching the actual behavior of the commands this hook exists to keep working, rather than inventing an upstream-lookup path those commands don't use.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — REMOTE=origin unconditionally for merge/tag/pr mint sources, matching the hardcoded convention in commands/merge.md and skill-tag/SKILL.md)*
